create_layer_mask: create a LayerParamMasking instance and add a boolean mask buffer to a PyTorch parameterized layer
setup_mask_param: setup a boolean mask tensor for a PyTorch parameter with shape and dtype validation
update_layer_mask: update an existing layer mask buffer in-place with a new boolean tensor
apply_mask_weight_gradient: apply a layer mask to weights and gradients during forward and backward passes
enable_disable_masks: enable or disable all active layer masks on a LayerParamMasking instance
